definitions.explanation: A building where goods are manufactured or processed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{工場|こうじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いています→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My father works at a factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工場|こうじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られました→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This car was made at a factory in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{工場|こうじょう}⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Next month, I plan to go on a factory tour with the kids.

notes:
{工場|こうじょう} means factory—a place where goods are manufactured.

ETYMOLOGY:
{工|こう} (craft) + {場|じょう} (place) = manufacturing place

PRONUNCIATION:
- こうじょう: standard, larger factories
- こうば: smaller workshops, often family-run

COMPOUNDS:
- {工場|こうじょう}⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: factory tour
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}{長|ちょう}→工場長：25657_koujouchou⟧: factory manager
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧{工場|こうじょう}: food factory
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧{工場|こうじょう}: automobile plant

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧: manufacturing
- ⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: production
- ⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧: industry

CULTURAL NOTE:
{工場|こうじょう}⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧ (factory tours) are popular in Japan—many food/beverage companies offer free tours with samples.
